messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy to prod finished (canary). Observability alert: error rate spike on ingestion-service. Triggering pager and incident channel.
inc-bot: PagerDuty P1 triggered -> alice (oncall). Incident channel created: #inc-4890001111.
alice: ACK. Investigating, pulling canary logs now.
alice: quick tail from canary: `2026-03-17T12:05:10Z ERROR decrypt failed: KMS.DecryptAccessDenied key=alias/rdwd-prod-ingest` — multiple instances show the same.
ben: I'm available. Looks like KMS.Decrypt errors rather than app NPEs. Could be alias/key mismatch.
carla: Release note: we performed an alias swap as part of the rollout (staging->prod key rotation). Was supposed to be a single atomic alias update.
dave: Checking KMS console and CloudTrail. I see `UpdateAlias` calls but some hosts still resolving to the old key due to eventual consistency and an interrupted terraform apply in eu-west-1.
alice: That matches symptoms — partial key mapping causing intermittent decrypt failures. Impact: roughly 15-25% of ingestion requests failing, spikes concentrated in eu-west-1 canary hosts.
eve: Customer impact: a few enterprise customers reported upload/embedding timeouts; CS notified 1 customer already. No broad data loss, just failures to process new payloads.
carla: Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback alias to old key, 2) enable temporary fallback to env-stored legacy key in app via feature flag, 3) rollback the deploy. I recommend toggling fallback flag to restore service fastest, then revert alias.
alice: Agreed. Carla — can you flip the flag? I can pause the rollout once we see recovery.
carla: Flipping feature flag `ingest_kms_fallback` -> true now (will make app use encrypted env var legacy key when KMS fails).
carla: :white_check_mark: Flag flipped. Pausing canary progression.
alice: Watching metrics... success rate returning to baseline within two minutes. Good. Proceed to stabilize.
dave: I'll perform alias rollback to old key id across all affected regions to remove race window. Running: `aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/rdwd-prod-ingest --target-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:old-key-id` and propagate.
dave: Alias rollback applied and confirmed via CloudTrail and describe-alias checks in all partitions.
alice: Re-running health checks on canaries — error rate back to normal. No further 5xx spikes.
ben: Taking incident for follow-up. Action items: 1) postmortem, 2) add terraform guard to ensure alias update completes and is verified across regions before confirming rollout, 3) add rollout health-gate that checks KMS decrypt success before allowing progressive canary steps, 4) audit runbooks for feature-flag fallback.
inc-bot: Incident P1 resolved. Duration ~18m. Created follow-up issue: github.com/redwood/inference/postmortems/issues/142
alice: Handing off to ben for follow-up. Great quick mitigation everyone. :thumbsup:
ben: I'll own the postmortem and the infra fixes. Assigning owners and ETA for fixes in issue.
eve: Noting CS update: notified impacted customers with temporary mitigation and timeline for permanent fix.
alice: Closing incident channel after doc + owners set. Thanks all.
